title: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 125B-A6B UD-Q2_K_XL on Strix Halo: Ollama (llama.cpp runner), Vulkan, Windows
slug_note: Measured by a third-party fleet host: the whole 125B model fits in 128 GB unified memory at 262K context, decoding at 19.95 tok/s.

variation.quant_detail: UD-Q2_K_XL, republished as the single-blob Ollama tag frob/qwen3.8-flash-next:125b-a6b-ud-q2_K_XL (78.87 GB)

engine.config: Ollama 0.33.2 (llama.cpp b10630) llama.cpp runner, Vulkan backend; OLLAMA_VULKAN=1 OLLAMA_IGPU_ENABLE=1; runner -c 262144 -np 1 --flash-attn auto -b 512 -ub 512; 49/49 layers offloaded

requirements.notes: Resident weights 51.3 GiB (55.09 GB) per the comment, with the OS agreeing; the comment says the n-gram table does not all become resident. 79.8 GB is the disk size including the vision projector. Host: 127.15 GB unified, Windows 11 build 26200.

steps.text: Pull the single-blob tag frob/qwen3.8-flash-next:125b-a6b-ud-q2_K_XL from ollama.com (the Hugging Face route fails because Ollama refuses sharded GGUF)
Run at 262,144 context with one slot; the comment shows the runner flags but not the exact ollama command

caveats: Measured by the issue author's fleet host, not by the Ollama or unsloth teams.
The comment says Ollama's llama.cpp runner cannot load this architecture natively; it ran through the Vulkan integrated-GPU path.
The comment text dates the measurement 2026-09-06 while the comment is stamped 2026-09-05 (UTC); the text's date is used.
The tag is frob's republish of unsloth's UD-Q2_K_XL, not an official Qwen or unsloth Ollama tag.
